verdict.rationale: Kling's own docs describe an Elements system that keeps character identity and voice persistent across multiple shots and scenes. This is cross-shot consistency, not just reference inputs. Multi-shot storyboarding of up to 6 cuts supports the multi-shot workflow. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how Elements works and its limits, explicit evidence that scene/environment consistency (not just characters) holds across separate generations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, a character or scene stays consistent across multiple generated shots, not just within one clip

citations.quote: Elements system for persistent character identity and voice across multiple shots and scenes (3.0 Omni)
Multi-shot storyboarding with per-shot camera control (pan, tilt, zoom, dolly, handheld) up to 6 cuts
Supports multiple ways to generate image series, with coherent storytelling and a consistent visual style.
